title: Constant-model constructibility is Zariski local on qcqs schemes
statement: Let $\Lambda$ be a commutative condensed ring [sk-def-sfb-condensed-ring]. For every scheme $T$ [def-pc-scheme] put $\Lambda_T=p_T^*\Lambda$ [sk-def-sfb-pulled-back-coefficients] on the small pro-étale site [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site], use internal module objects [sk-def-sfb-module-objects], and for an open immersion $w:W\hookrightarrow T$ [def-weil-open-immersion] write $N|_W=w^*N$ for the module inverse image [sk-def-sfb-module-pushforward-pullback]. For a quasi-compact [def-weil-pbc-quasi-compact-scheme] and quasi-separated [def-weil-quasi-separated-morphism] scheme $W$, call a $\Lambda_W$-module $N$ *stratified constructible* if there is a finite stratification $W=\coprod_aW_a$ by locally closed subschemes [def-constructible-stratification] whose underlying sets are constructible subsets of $|W|$ [def-weil-constructible-subset] such that every restriction $N|_{W_a}$ has a finite constant local model [det-def-sfb-constructible-local-model]; this is the qcqs clause of [sk-def-sfb-constructible]. Let $Y$ be a scheme and $M$ a $\Lambda_Y$-module. (1) If $Y$ is quasi-compact and quasi-separated and $M$ is stratified constructible, then $M|_W$ is stratified constructible for every quasi-compact open subscheme $W\subseteq Y$. (2) If $W\subseteq Y$ is a quasi-compact quasi-separated open subscheme and $W=W_1\cup\dots\cup W_r$ is a finite cover by quasi-compact open subschemes such that every $M|_{W_k}$ is stratified constructible, then $M|_W$ is stratified constructible. In particular, for a quasi-compact quasi-separated scheme $Y$, $M$ is stratified constructible if and only if $M|_V$ is stratified constructible for every affine open $V\subseteq Y$, so the affine-local and the finite-stratification conditions of [sk-def-sfb-constructible] agree there. Empty schemes, $r=0$, empty strata and $M=0$ are allowed; no Noetherian hypothesis is imposed.

source.place: Topology, Lemmas 005J (lemma-open-immersion-constructible-inverse-image), 09YD (lemma-quasi-compact-open-immersion-constructible-image) and 053W (lemma-collate-constructible), applied to the strata of [sk-def-sfb-constructible] (blueprint main-20261015 sec-proetale-coefficients/sk-def-sfb-constructible/_section.md, part 2: 'On an arbitrary scheme this condition is imposed locally on affine opens'); serves steps 2 and 4 of lem-sfb-qc-open-extension-ctf.

proof.text: Transport finite constant local models across an isomorphism by retaining the cover and finitely presented coefficient modules, composing the inverse image of the inverse isomorphism with each model isomorphism. Transport stratified constructibility similarly on every stratum.

For any scheme morphism g, pull a witnessing Scheme.Stratification back using lemma-constructible-pullback-stratification. Its constructibility field is already supplied by that declaration. Pull the finite constant local model on each original stratum back along the first projection using new-unbounded-pullback-finite-constant-local-model. The pullback square and the inverse-image composition isomorphisms identify this with the restriction of g* M to the new stratum. This proves arbitrary pullback stability, hence clause (1), without needing qcqs hypotheses for this step.

On a qcqs scheme with a stratified affine neighbourhood at each point, compactness extracts finitely many such affine opens. Reindex their finite subtype by Fin n, choose the witnessing local stratifications, and apply lem-weil-pbc-etale-stratification-local-gluing-core. Each resulting global stratum has an actual factorization q through a local stratum. Pull its local model along q, and compose upperStarComp and the factorization equality to obtain the model on the global stratum. This proves stratified constructibility of the original module. On an empty scheme the finite subcover and resulting stratification may be empty; no local witness is chosen at an absent point.

For clause (2), turn compactness of W into CompactSpace W and use its given quasi-separatedness. At each x in W choose one covering open U_k. The affine-open basis gives an affine V containing x and contained in U_k. Apply arbitrary pullback stability from step 2 along W.homOfLE : V → U_k to the given stratification. The equality homOfLE ≫ U_k.ι = V.ι and upperStarComp identify this pullback with the restriction of M|W to V. Step 3 glues these affine neighbourhoods. Compactness of the covering members is not needed by this stronger restriction argument.

For clause (3), arbitrary pullback stability gives the forward implication. Conversely, the affine basis provides a neighbourhood of each point; the hypothesis provides a stratification there, and step 3 gives a global stratification. This avoids passing through the top open and a pullback-along-identity comparison.

lean.statement: theorem finiteConstantStratified_zariski_locality (Λ : Sheaf (coherentTopology Profinite.{u}) Ab.{u + 1}) [MonObj Λ] [IsCommMonObj Λ] (Y : Scheme.{u}) (M : Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology Y) Ab.{u + 1}) (condensedRingObj Λ Y)) : (CompactSpace Y → QuasiSeparatedSpace Y → IsFiniteConstantStratified Λ Y M → ∀ W : Y.Opens, IsCompact (W : Set Y) → IsFiniteConstantStratified Λ W.toScheme ((CondensedRing.upperStar Λ W.ι).obj M)) ∧ (∀ W : Y.Opens, IsCompact (W : Set Y) → QuasiSeparatedSpace W.toScheme → ∀ (r : ℕ) (U : Fin r → W.toScheme.Opens), (∀ k : Fin r, IsCompact (U k : Set W.toScheme)) → (⋃ k : Fin r, (U k : Set W.toScheme)) = Set.univ → (∀ k : Fin r, IsFiniteConstantStratified Λ (U k).toScheme ((CondensedRing.upperStar Λ ((U k).ι ≫ W.ι)).obj M)) → IsFiniteConstantStratified Λ W.toScheme ((CondensedRing.upperStar Λ W.ι).obj M)) ∧ (CompactSpace Y → QuasiSeparatedSpace Y → (IsFiniteConstantStratified Λ Y M ↔ ∀ V : Y.Opens, IsAffineOpen V → IsFiniteConstantStratified Λ V.toScheme ((CondensedRing.upperStar Λ V.ι).obj M)))
